answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a distinct clearing-margin escrow whose collateral provenance forms a vine of attested transfers, so fake accounts cannot replicate the root history. Each new counterparty must publish a signed sonnet of its exposure schedule, and peers verify the echo of that schedule against prior SVaR backtests before. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
